name: secret-management
description: Store, access, rotate, and audit secrets safely — provider selection (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager), runtime injection, rotation policy, least-privilege IAM, CI/CD secret handling, and secret scanning in pipelines. Use when asked to "store API keys", "rotate secrets", "Vault", "AWS Secrets Manager", "secret rotation", "least privilege", "secrets in CI", "secret scanning", "gitleaks", "trufflehog", "don't hardcode credentials", or "how to manage secrets in production". Do NOT use for: general auth token lifecycle — see auth-patterns. Do NOT use for: environment variable naming conventions alone — this covers secret storage architecture.
